name: 3D Gaussian Particle Approximation of VDB Datasets
definition: A SciVis rendering approach that converts OpenVDB volumetric datasets into a set of non-overlapping 3D Gaussian particles to enable memory-efficient, lossy representation with Level of Detail (LOD) support, rendered via forward ray marching using NVIDIA OptiX.
summary: This method converts OpenVDB datasets into non-overlapping 3D Gaussian particles for memory-efficient, real-time rendering with Level of Detail support.
